title: Feature Request: Allow generation of Formatter for a type in a referenced assembly
intent: A project that references a library type with no MessagePack attributes can get a source-generated formatter for that type inside the referencing project.

functional.text: A [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] attribute on a partial class that implements IMessagePackFormatter<T> makes the generator write the formatter for T.
The type T can be declared in a referenced project that has no reference to the MessagePack package.
The generated formatter is registered with the generated resolver without extra setup.
Keys and membership can be described declaratively in the user's code, without attributes on T.
Public members of T are serialized.

nonFunctional.text: The library that declares T gains no new dependency. (inferred)
A generated formatter works with trimming and NativeAOT, as other generated formatters do. (inferred)

derivedFrom.note: Derived by the evidence lane from the upstream issue text on 2026-11-14; not Tieto's requirements set.
